unidades: px do boneco de 38 px (o esqueleto multiplica pela escala)

arcane/arcane-beam.desc: A beam fires right from the hand: a white core, strands twisting round it, pulses running down it, a flaring source and an end that sprays sparks.

arcane/arcane-missiles.desc: A volley of violet bolts fans out of the hand, curls round on twisting ribbons and pops on the target one after another.

arcane/blink-in.desc: Glittering bits spiral in to a point of light that opens into a line, then into a white silhouette that cools into the caster.

arcane/blink-out.desc: The caster crackles with gathering light, flashes white, squeezes into a line of light that collapses and pops away in sparks.

arcane/spell-charge.desc: Energy gathers in the caster's hand: streaks and motes spiral in, rings collapse into a swelling orb that crackles with arcs, ready to fire.

fire/fire-ring.desc: A white flash at the feet, then flames race outward along the floor in a ring, flaring as the front passes and burning down behind it over a smouldering scorch.

holy/blessing.desc: A soft cone of light rests on the character from above; sparkles drift down through it, twinkling, and wink out where they land on the head and shoulders.

holy/divine-shield.desc: A bubble of gold light round the character: a bright rim and a thin gold film, meridians turning like a slow globe, a sheen sweeping across and sparkles winking on it.

holy/halo.desc: A ring of gold light floats over the head with a glint running round it; fine dust sifts down from it and the head catches its light.

holy/heal.desc: Petals of light bloom under the feet, a hoop of light rises up the body restoring its colour and leaving sparkles, and motes spiral up and pop into tiny hearts.

holy/resurrection.desc: Light pours down on the fallen and life climbs back up the body; wings of light unfold, a halo forms, one great wingbeat, then the wings scatter into feathers.

ice/freeze.desc: Frost races in and climbs the character, turning it to ice; a faceted block crystallizes round it pane by pane, glints, cracks and bursts, and the character thaws free.

ice/frost-nova.desc: Frost spirals into a spinning snowflake, then a wave blooms three rings of ice crystals round the caster; snow drifts, frost creeps, and the ice melts back into the floor.

impacts/heavy-landing.desc: A character lands hard: the floor dents and cracks under their feet, two rings of dust roll out along the floor one after the other, and pebbles hop away.

impacts/hit-flash.desc: The character takes damage: a white frame, then their own colors flushed red and blinking white, cooling off, while comic hit lines jab in at them.

impacts/shield-block.desc: A blow is caught on a half-dome of energy in front of the character: its diamond lattice flashes, a ripple runs over it, sparks glance off, then it blinks out cell by cell.

lightning/chain-lightning.desc: A bolt leaps from the caster's hand through three targets in turn; each flashes, sparks and grounds itself to the floor while the arcs between them flicker, then the chain snaps.

lightning/charge-up.desc: Sparks streak and arcs whip in to a crackling core at the caster's hand that swells and pulses faster, then it flashes and bursts: bolts every way, a ring, a spray of sparks.

lightning/electrified.desc: Current runs through a character: arcs crawl over and leap across the body, sparks spit off, the body flares to an electric silhouette on each jolt, and the feet ground out.

lightning/thunderclap.desc: A thunderclap round the caster: a white flash, forked bolts burst out and stab the floor, a heavy shock ring tears across the ground raising dust and grit, sparks streak away.

melee/claw-swipe.desc: Three claw marks rake down one after another, white-hot, cooling through orange to red, then close up from both ends and leave a dotted scar, with hot flecks and drips.

melee/dagger-flurry.desc: A flurry of small quick crescents at every angle in front of the fighter, each with a flick of sparks, finished by one big cut that glints and bursts.

melee/double-slash.desc: A down cut, then an up cut that crosses it: the moment the X closes both strokes flash white, the crossing bursts with light and sparks, and a dotted X lingers.

melee/hammer-smash.desc: A hammer drops in front in a wedge of motion: a white slam with rays, a dome of force, a dent with cracks, rocks thrown up that bounce and settle, and dust.

melee/heavy-cleave.desc: A glint over the head, then a thick ember arc accelerates over the top into the floor: a white slam, glowing cracks, dust rolling both ways, grit and rising embers.

melee/scythe-reap.desc: A slow, huge dark crescent reaps round the front with a pale ghostly edge; it hangs, then tears away from the tail into curling wisps and cold vapour.

melee/spear-sweep.desc: A wide low sweep at shin height: a long flat crescent swings from behind the legs round the front, and the wind of it kicks a wake of dust and grit along the floor.

melee/spin-slash.desc: The blade whirls once round the waist on a tilted plane, behind the body and back in front; the closed ring flares white, dissolves into a dotted trace and throws sparks.

melee/sword-slash.desc: A tilted crescent whips round in two frames, cools from white to deep blue as it trails off, glints at the tip and throws sparks.

melee/thrust.desc: A piercing stab: a bundle of streaks shoots out from the hand to a point, a long four-point star flares at the tip with a pierce ring, sparks and speed lines.

melee/uppercut.desc: A crescent rises from the floor past the face, and at the top a comic impact star bursts: bold outline, hot core, burst lines, twinkles and sparks.

melee/whip-crack.desc: A whip rolls out to the right as a loop running down its length, faster and faster, until the tip flips over and cracks: a white pop, a ring of air, sparks and a puff of smoke.

moves/arrow-shot.desc: He raises the bow, draws to his cheek, holds his breath and looses: the string snaps forward, the arrow crosses the floor and thuds home.

moves/dash-strike.desc: A crouch, then he's across the floor in a blur of after-images and already cutting: a critical hit, a beat, and he hops back to where he started.

moves/earth-stomp.desc: A knee comes up, the boot slams down, the floor heaves under the target and a stone spike rams up through it.

moves/fireball-throw.desc: He gathers fire in his hand, leans back and hurls it: the ball flies, the target takes it in a blast and comes out charred.

moves/ground-pound.desc: He coils, leaps out of frame height, hangs, and comes down like a rock: the floor cracks, shock waves race out and throw the target about as they pass.

moves/holy-smite.desc: Both hands go up and a glint marks the target; he brings them down and a bolt of light drops like a hammer, leaving the target blanched.

moves/ice-lance-throw.desc: Frost gathers into a spear in his hand, he throws it like a javelin, and the target ices over in a burst of snowflakes and shivers.

moves/lightning-call.desc: An arm goes up, a sigil lights under the target, and on the downswing a thick bolt comes down on it; the target jolts through the aftershocks.

moves/meteor-call.desc: A long chant: a circle draws itself round him, it flares, he points, and a burning rock comes down on the target and flattens the scene.

moves/pistol-shots.desc: Three aimed shots: the gun kicks up each time and settles, tracers cross the floor, and the target staggers under each hit.

moves/rocket-launcher.desc: He drops to one knee, shoulders the tube and fires: the kick shoves him back along the floor, the rocket crawls out on its jet and the target goes up.

moves/sword-combo.desc: Three strokes walking forward: a slash, a crossing double cut, and a two-handed cleave into the floor that throws the target about.

nature/leaf-storm.desc: Leaves tumble up a rising spiral round the character, passing behind and in front, turning and flipping, wrapped in bright bands of wind; litter swirls at their feet.

nature/root-snare.desc: The floor cracks and roots burst up round the character, spiralling round its legs; they cinch tight with a snap, hold, then crack and crumble into bark and dust.

scifi/force-field.desc: A glassy dome of hex plates over the hero: plates glint, tracers from the right slam into it, a ripple and cracks of light race across, sparks glance off.

scifi/glitch.desc: The hero's signal breaks up in bursts: an RGB split, slices torn sideways, rows smeared out, junk blocks and dead pixels, then snaps back clean.

scifi/scanner.desc: Brackets snap onto the hero, a scan line sweeps head to toe leaving a cooling outline, and a readout counts up to OK before it all lets go.

scifi/warp-in.desc: A beam slams down, rings run down it and a scanline paints the hero in from head to toe, white-hot pixels cooling to their own colors; the beam pinches shut in sparks.

scifi/warp-out.desc: The hero's outline flickers on, they flash white and break into light from the head down, streaming up a beam that lifts off the floor and pinches shut.

shadow/curse.desc: Wisps gather over the head, a skull stamps down with a flash, its eyes burn as the curse floods the body violet, then it cracks and crumbles.

shadow/life-steal.desc: A target on the right is struck and bleeds red orbs; they hang a moment, then whip home as comet streaks and flood the caster crimson.

spawn/disintegrate.desc: The character crackles with light, flashes white, then peels away from the head down: each pixel flares white-hot and streams off on the wind as a cooling mote of light.

spawn/dissolve-burn.desc: An ember seam lights at the feet and climbs the body: above it the body scorches and smoulders, at it flames lick up, below it there's only falling ash, embers and smoke.

spawn/respawn-beam.desc: A guide line drops, a pillar of light slams onto the spot, and a scan bar climbs from the feet writing the character back in row by row, white-hot lines cooling to its colors.

spawn/shatter-death.desc: Frost races up the body and seals it in faceted ice, a glint sweeps it, cracks spread from the chest, then it bursts into its own facets that tumble, bounce and melt.

spawn/soul-rise.desc: The body's outline flares and dims, then a pale glowing copy of it lifts out, stretching as its legs melt into a rippling wisp, shedding motes until it thins into light.

status/bleeding.desc: Bleeding out: beads swell at three wounds, run, let go and fall to spatter into a glossy pool that ripples; each heartbeat spurts a little and flashes the body red.

status/burning.desc: Burning over time: small flames lick from four hot spots, trailing sparks and thin smoke; every 0.6 s they flare, the body flashes white then orange, scorch marks spread.

status/charmed.desc: Smitten: a big heart beats over the head, throwing a ring and a flush of light with every beat, little hearts float up, the eyes go pink and the cheeks blush.

status/confused.desc: Head in a spin: a glowing spiral whirls over the head, question marks pop up round it and bob, the eyes dart left and right.

status/cursed.desc: Hexed: violet smoke rises off the body in winding trails, a dark stain creeps up from the feet with a glowing edge, the eyes burn, a skull glitches in overhead.

status/frozen.desc: Chilled to the bone: frost ferns creep over the body, icicles hang from chin and hands and drip, breath steams, snow settles, a shiver every second, frost spreads underfoot.

status/haste.desc: Sped up: striped after-images stream out behind, speed lines whip past, dust kicks off the heels and the leading edge catches the wind. Faces right.

status/petrified.desc: Turned to stone: grey creeps up from the feet behind a crackling edge that spits grit, the statue holds, cracks run through it, and it bursts into tumbling chunks and dust.

status/poisoned.desc: Sick to the bone: green rolls up the body in waves, dark veins creep from a wound, toxic sweat drips and hisses; every 0.8 s it wobbles, blisters pop and a ring pulses out.

status/rage.desc: Seething: the body judders on every heartbeat, an anger mark throbs at the temple, eyes burn, steam jets off the head, stress lines flash out and the floor cracks hot underfoot.

status/sleep.desc: Fast asleep: eyes shut, soft outlined Zs float up off the head one after another, swaying and growing as they rise, dream motes drift, a slow breathing glow.

status/slowed.desc: Dragged through time: a glassy clock dial behind the head ticks round in heavy steps, flashing with each, while drops sink in slow motion and spread slow rings.

status/stunned.desc: Seeing stars: three spinning stars and two little birds circle the head on a tilted ring, ducking behind it and sweeping round in front, trailing glitter.

ui/exclamation.desc: A bold ! springs up off the hero's head, stretching as it shoots up and squashing as it lands; surprise ticks flick out, it wobbles, then pops away.

ui/level-up.desc: Gold gathers at the feet and bursts up as a pillar of light round the hero; rings climb it, LEVEL UP! drops in letter by letter, a shine sweeps it, sparkles twinkle.
